_template: Copy this with scripts/new-subagent.sh <name>, or by hand into scripts/presets/<name>.json. Keys beginning with _ are documentation only and are stripped by the scaffold. See docs/subagents.md.

_fields.preset_name: Unique id; how you select the subagent (run_subagent preset, launcher --agent).
_fields.provider: openrouter | local | lmstudio | ollama | anthropic | openai | auto.
_fields.model: Provider model id (e.g. deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro, or a local model name).
_fields.resource: Broker hint: remote | gpu | cpu | gpu+cpu (local-first scheduling).
_fields.system_prompt: The subagent's role/instructions. Keep it self-contained.
_fields.allowed_tools: Whitelist of tool names. Omit edit/write/bash for a read-only agent.
_fields.max_context: Max context tokens the model is told it has.
_fields.timeout_seconds: Hard wall-clock bound for an isolated run.
_fields.tier_ref: Optional orchestrator key into config/model_tiers.json for local->remote laddering.

description: REPLACE_ME — one line on what this subagent is for.
system_prompt: You are a focused claw-code subagent. State your role and constraints here. You are read-only unless the preset grants write tools.
